_readme: H12 start-from-zero rehearsal: the REAL pieces on private ports, never touching the live stack (live: engine 8107, shell 8206, site 8210). The engine is a COPY of the exe in an isolated cwd (.h12_scratch/engine) on private port 8137, spawned DIRECTLY (no launch_chimera.bat) to validate the direct-exe supervisor fix. Shell and site are the real servers on 8246/8245, loopback, health-checked only. Torn down after the rehearsal.
